card.name: Inside drug names: 'ar' and 'ur'
card.fires_on: The short piece 'ar' (also 'R', 'ur') partway through a drug name, such as nirap-ar-ib, talazop-ar-ib, seladelp-ar and fondap-ar-inux. It appears in drug labels.

modes.label: PARP inhibitor names
modes.description: The 'ar' inside names ending in -parib, before 'ib'.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of AKEEGA is 200 mg nirap<<ar>>ib/1,000 mg

modes.label: Other drug names
modes.description: A short piece in the middle of other drug names, such as seladelpar, fondaparinux, tubocurarine or Adcetris.
modes.example: Probenecid ↑ seladelp<<ar>> Avoid concomitant administration of LIV

card.plain: It fires on a small piece in the middle of certain drug names, especially niraparib and similar names.
